decision.question: Why is the local Ion-Cu coulombic efficiency lower than the matched literature reference?
decision.summary: The local result is lower under matched nominal conditions; surface re-oxidation is the leading testable explanation, but contamination remains plausible.
limitations: Synthetic demonstration fixture; not a real scientific result.

verification_plan.action: Run a paired, approved surface-recovery intervention with untreated and clean-handling controls, then repeat the same CE protocol.
verification_plan.minimal_change: Change only surface recovery/handling while keeping Cond-A fixed.
expected_outcomes: Oxidation hypothesis: surface indicator and CE recover together.
Contamination hypothesis: cleaning improves CE without oxidation change.
verification_plan.decision_rule: Upgrade H1 only if the paired intervention restores the surface indicator and CE beyond repeat variability while the clean-handling control does not explain the change.
verification_plan.cost: Low to moderate; three paired groups.
verification_plan.risk: Requires approved handling and no unreviewed chemical procedure.
verification_plan.safety: Follow the existing laboratory SOP and SDS; no executable treatment parameters are supplied.
verification_plan.priority_rationale: One paired intervention and two measurements address both leading chains while keeping Cond-A fixed.

information_gain.decision_change: Can upgrade one surface-state pathway, reject both, or stop material optimization and return to data-quality review.
information_gain.basis: Coverage of the two unresolved mediator nodes with paired controls.

verification_plan.sample_consumption: Three paired groups with three repeats each.
verification_plan.stop_rule: Stop mechanism escalation if measurement repeatability is inadequate or neither surface state nor resistance changes with the intervention.

facts: Air exposure is associated with lower CE under Cond-A in this synthetic fixture; the structure and interfacial-property mediators remain unmeasured.
